latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Movie Maker Microsoft Free Download — AI-powered online video editing, no installation needed.

- Upload video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WMV, up to 500MB) for quick edits and 1080p MP4 export, all processed in the cloud.
- Fast, automated editing via natural language instructions (e.g., "trim footage, add transitions, and export").
- Simple onboarding: obtain free token (100 credits, 7 days), auto-authenticate and create editing sessions.
- Integrated workflows for editing, file upload, downloading, credits check, timeline previews, and error handling.
- Guides users with clear prompts and summaries of timeline changes; handles all back-end API steps for you.
